Suit chunein

Collection mein se apna pasandeeda rang aur design dekhein.

WhatsApp par likhein

Suit ke neeche "WhatsApp par order karein" dabayein. Suit ka naam khud message mein aa jayega.

Confirm karein

Price, delivery aur payment ki tafseel WhatsApp par confirm hoti hai.

Aap ke sawaal

Aksar pooche jane wale sawaal

Price kitni hai?

Har suit ki price WhatsApp par bata di jati hai. Jald hi price website par bhi nazar aayegi.

Delivery kab tak hoti hai?

Delivery ka waqt aur charges order confirm karte waqt WhatsApp par bata diye jate hain.

Payment kaise hogi?

Payment ka tareeqa order ke waqt WhatsApp par confirm kiya jata hai. Card ki detail is website par kabhi nahi li jati.

Rang tasveer jaisa hoga?

Hum asli suit ki tasveeren lagate hain. Screen ki wajah se rang halka sa mukhtalif nazar aa sakta hai.
